source: segmentation (Blender render with background replaced by white)
units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the cart region vs frame 0: max shift 0.3 px over all 59 frames; house/cart masks identical apart from 1-3 px segmentation-edge flicker
camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate per question from given depths + a known size)
camera.perspective_cues: No ground plane, horizon or shadows visible (background removed). House is seen nearly frontally (gable wall facing camera, horizontal beams almost horizontal). Cart is seen in 3/4 view: its long axis recedes from front-left (shafts, x~1300) to back-right (x~1890), so the cart's pixel length is foreshortened. House wall bottom y~1170, cart wheel bottom y~1267: both stand on an (invisible) ground.

objects.name: bird
objects.description: dark (black/grey) flying bird, crow/blackbird-like, with white/grey wing undersides; the only moving object
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = centroid of the segmented bird mask (body+wings). cx_smooth9,cy_smooth9 = 9-frame centred moving average (about one wing-beat) to remove wing-flap wobble of the centroid; closer to the body/origin path
objects.path_summary: flies left to right in front of the house gable at nearly constant image height (cy 761-847). x: 355 (f0) -> 1350 (f50) -> 1423 (f58). Frames 0-33 over the house wall (bird drawn in front of it), 34-58 against empty background, passing above the cart at the end.
objects.apparent_size: wing-beat-cycle maximum of the mask main-axis length (approx wingspan in image): ~171 px (f4), ~143 (f18), ~145 (f21), ~149 (f28), ~156 (f38), ~166 (f49), then drops to ~100 (f52) and ~94 (f55), 79-91 (f56-58). sqrt(area) cycle maxima ~79-95 px for f0-50, ~52 px f55. Roughly constant depth during f0-50; during f51-58 the bird shrinks to ~0.55-0.6 of its size and its image-x speed drops from ~20 to ~7 px/frame while it moves down slightly: it turns and flies away from the camera (depth increases) - also its pose changes (seen from behind/below), so size ratio is only an approximate depth ratio.

objects.name: house
objects.description: small wooden half-timbered house/shed, gable end facing camera, crossed roof beams at the ridge, open dark doorway with a plank door leaf to its left, climbing rose plant (green with pink flowers) on the right of the doorway; left part of image

parts_px_approx.crossed_ridge_beams_top: tips at y ~353 (left beam tip ~(445,355), right ~(680,360)); crossing ~(566,467)
parts_px_approx.front_wall: x ~208 to ~912 (width ~705 px) at y~900; wall bottom ~1170 on the left; right lower part of the wall is cut by the segmentation at y~1050
parts_px_approx.ridge_to_wall_bottom_height: ~700 px (y 467 -> 1170); total height incl. beam tips ~823 px

objects.name: cart
objects.description: dark green/black wooden two-wheeled hand cart (handcart) with two long shafts pointing to the front-left; right part of image, below the bird's final position

parts_px_approx.far_wheel: partly hidden, visible lower arc around x ~1560-1650, y ~1200-1240
parts_px_approx.box: front-left top corner ~(1472,1090), rear-right top corner ~(1862,1012), rear end x ~1890
parts_px_approx.length_axis: image direction of the cart's long axis: from shaft tip (1300,1235) to rear (1890,1030), ~625 px (foreshortened, 3/4 view)

events.event: bird already flying at frame 0 and keeps flying to frame 58 (no start/stop, never leaves the frame)
wing-beats: mask area minima (wings edge-on / folded) at frames ~1, 9-10, 19, 27, 36, 44, 53; maxima (wings spread) at ~5-6, 14, 32, 39, 49; period ~8.6 frames (~0.39 s, ~2.6 Hz)
bird centroid leaves the house silhouette (passes right roof edge) into empty background
bird turns away from camera: image x-speed drops and apparent size shrinks
last frame; bird above the cart near (1423,846)
